messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] Starting rollout for feature 'new-routing' (tag: routing:2026.03.15-9a3f). Flag=enable_new_routing. Plan: 0% -> 50% over 20m with holdback shards hb-A=5%, hb-B=5%. Canary: shard-1. Auto-rollback threshold: error_rate > 2.5%.

maria (eng-release): let's pin the runtime image and config to avoid drift during the ramp.

raj (eng-platform): on it. running `redwoodctl pin --service routing --image=registry/redwood/routing:20260315-9a3f` now.

ci-bot: Pin job succeeded: pin id abc123. Artifact digest: sha256:deadbeefcafebabe.

jon (prod-eng): prefer a slower ramp if possible. holdbacks look fine, but increase logging on hb-B for first 10m.

maria (eng-release): agreed — raj can you bump hb-B to DEBUG for initial observability window?

raj (eng-platform): done. `kubectl set env deploy/routing LOG_LEVEL=debug --namespace=prod --selector=holdback=hb-B`

deploy-bot: Ramp progress: advanced 10% -> 30% (t+6m). Observed error_rate 0.9%, p95 latency stable.

sylvia (sre): noticed a small spike on a pod in shard-1 — error_rate hit 2.1% for ~1m. I'm placing a manual hold at 30% until we validate.

jon (prod-eng): hold the ramp. policy: if error_rate > 2% for 3m -> rollback. snapshot logs for shard-1 and tag the timeframe.

maria (eng-release): taking snapshot now: `redwoodctl snapshot logs --service routing --since 5m --target=ops-s3/hb-shard1`

deploy-bot: Snapshot job queued. Ramp paused (manual hold by sylvia). Current status: paused at 30%.

raj (eng-platform): dug into the logs — found a null pointer in header parsing coming from aws-sdk v2 after the new routing change. I'm rolling back that subchange on canary nodes.

jon (prod-eng): rollback plan: revert holdbacks to routing:20260228-stable and abort the rest of the rollout. Resume gradual ramp tomorrow 02:00 UTC after fixes. Approve?

maria (eng-release): approve. rollback command for ops: `redwoodctl rollout revert --service routing --image=registry/redwood/routing:20260228-stable --target=holdbacks`

deploy-bot: Manual rollback initiated by jon (prod-eng). Revert job started. ETA ~7m. Will post updates. :repeat: 

ci-bot: Revert completed. Active image on holdbacks: routing:20260228-stable. Healthchecks passing (all hb pods).

sylvia (sre): alerting suppressed, healthchecks green. I'll open a follow-up if we see recurring anomalies. :thumbsup: 

maria (eng-release): notes for release notes: paused rollout due to header parsing NPE in aws-sdk v2; rolled back holdbacks to previous stable; next steps: pin aws-sdk in runtime and add targeted test. Assigning follow-up to raj.

raj (eng-platform): created PR #4321 to pin aws-sdk and add regression tests, requesting review from @maria and @jon.
